ocean.kelp-forest.name: Kelp Forest
ocean.kelp-forest.description: Layered rocky coastal habitat with tall kelp blades rising from holdfasts.
visual_cues: three or four tall kelp stipes

ocean.shallow-coral-reef.name: Shallow Coral Reef
ocean.shallow-coral-reef.description: Sunlit reef with large coral heads and clear open channels.

ocean.deep-coral-garden.name: Deep-Sea Coral Garden
ocean.deep-coral-garden.description: Dark deep habitat with sparse tree-, fan-, and feather-shaped cold-water corals on rock.

ocean.shipwreck-field.name: Shipwreck Field
ocean.shipwreck-field.description: Submerged wreck site with a few large recognizable structural remains.

ocean.sea-cave-mouth.name: Submerged Sea Cave
ocean.sea-cave-mouth.description: Wave-eroded rocky cavern opening into open water.

ocean.hydrothermal-vent-field.name: Hydrothermal Vent Field
ocean.hydrothermal-vent-field.description: Deep seafloor with a few large chimney structures and sparse vent-associated forms.

ocean.seamount-slope.name: Seamount Slope
ocean.seamount-slope.description: Steep underwater volcanic slope rising through open deep water.

ocean.open-water-dropoff.name: Open-Water Drop-Off
ocean.open-water-dropoff.description: Pelagic scene at the edge of a steep underwater wall, emphasizing depth and open water.
visual_cues: distant light gradient implied by line spacing

ocean.mangrove-lagoon.name: Mangrove Lagoon
ocean.mangrove-lagoon.description: Shallow coastal water structured by large arching roots and muddy sand.

ocean.tidepool-shelf.name: Rocky Tidepool Shelf
ocean.tidepool-shelf.description: Intertidal rock platform with a few large pools and exposed rock forms.
